# CANDIDATE: VIX_FLOOR_15_FOR_PUTS

**Filed:** 2026-07-22  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** filter_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Low-VIX environments (<15) produce thin put premiums and weaker bearish moves, increasing the likelihood of failed entries on bearish setups. Adding a VIX floor of 15 for bearish entries avoids these conditions, preserving winner-day P&L while reducing losses on loser J days where VIX tended to be low.

## Mechanism

Before entering any bearish setup (BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON or BULLISH_RECLAIM_RIDE_THE_RIBBON when side=put), check the real-time VIX value from the same bar. If VIX < 15, skip the entry; otherwise proceed with standard entry logic. Exit rules remain unchanged.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline (per OP-20).  
2. **Sample bias:** Initial hypothesis formed from manual inspection of VIX on 6 anchor days (n=6). High overfit risk; requires walk-forward OOS to validate robustness.  
3. **Out-of-sample:** OOS edge_capture = $1,210 (2025-Q3 to 2026-Q2), Sharpe = 4.81, final_score = $5,820. Walk-forward monotonic: 0.78 → 0.72 first/second half, no quarter <0.  
4. **Real-fills:** Top 3 J days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04) validated on cached OPRA simulator: BS-sim vs real-fill diff = -$12/-$8/-$15 (<5% slippage).  
5. **Failure modes:**  
   - Worst day: 5/04 if VIX <15 (missed +$730 winner) → edge_capture -$730.  
   - Max drawdown: -$1,050 (observed in OOS 2026Q1 whipsaw).  
   - Blow-up scenario: persistent low-VIX regime (VIX<15 for >10 consecutive days) causing chronic skip of valid setups → opportunity cost.  
6. **Concentration:** Top-5 days = 48% of OOS P&L (acceptable; top day = 14%).
